info.title: IdentityTwin Trust Gateway API
info.description: Behavioral identity and trust gateway for merchant payment operations. Enforces centralized risk assessment, policy-driven payout routing, and secure incident management.

get.description: Indicates that the API server process is alive and accepting connections.
Verifies that all required backend dependencies (database) are operational.

post.description: Ingests user telemetry, security, and behavioral telemetry bounded by session ownership.

get.summary: List active sessions for merchant domain

post.description: Initializes a new session bound to authenticated principal with baseline NORMAL trust level.

get.summary: Get session trust state by ID

post.description: Issues a time-bound step-up OTP challenge bound to session and merchant.
Validates step-up challenge code and issues a single-use verification token.

post.summary: Execute protected payout through Trust Gateway
post.description: All payout execution MUST pass through this endpoint and the central Trust Gateway service. Evaluates real-time risk, applies centralized routing policy, and strictly isolates or rejects non-eligible trust states.

get.description: Returns incidents scoped to the merchant domain.

post.description: Requires analyst credentials. Updates review status and records audit action. Approval does NOT automatically execute payouts or disable isolation.
Requires analyst credentials. Resolves incident and logs audit trail.

post.summary: Approve session revocation for security incident (Analyst/Admin Only)
post.description: Requires analyst/admin credentials and merchant domain ownership. Records the audit trail confirming session isolation and permanent revocation. Guaranteed to never re-enable a session or execute a payout.

post.summary: Receive and verify incoming PayPal Sandbox webhook events
post.description: Verifies cryptographic signature against PayPal Sandbox API. Enforces event idempotency and reconciles payout batch status. Unverified signatures are strictly rejected.
